block.title: Beach cities never cook at night

record.title: Beach cities never cook at night
record.body: Sixty-two degrees the moment the sun hits the Pacific. You forget how fast the marine layer pulls the heat out. Mid-April in El Segundo is a light hoodie after 18:30, every evening, like clockwork.
record.author: cc
